Subject: New supplier setup — LedgerWorks (initial packet)

Hi Sofia,

Thanks for the quick intro earlier. We're ready to be added to Redwood's supplier registry so your procurement team can issue POs. I've attached our company factsheet for the legal name and address, and included our preferred invoicing contact. A couple of quick details we want to confirm:

- Legal name on invoices: LedgerWorks Ltd. (we also trade as "LedgerWorks")
- VAT/Tax identifier: see attached (VAT: GB987654321)
- Preferred remittance email: invoices@ledgerworks.com
- PO routing: purchasing@ledgerworks.com

Can you confirm what fields Redwood needs (legal name vs DBA, remittance address, AP contact) and whether you require a W-9 / EU VAT certificate on file? We can return the completed packet within a day.

Attachments: LedgerWorks_Company_Info.pdf (company factsheet, VAT cert stub)

Best,
Elena Rossi

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>
To: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@ledgerworks.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 29 Jun 2027 12:03:00 +0000
Subject: Re: New supplier setup — LedgerWorks (initial packet)

Hi Elena — thanks for the packet, looks good. Looping in Kimberly (AP) and Marissa (Vendor Ops) to get LedgerWorks into our vendor registry and confirm PO routing.

Short checklist of what we need to complete the profile in our system:

1) Confirm legal entity exactly as it should appear on our records (we store both Legal Name and DBA).
2) Official tax identifier (VAT ID for EU entities, or W-9 for US entities).
3) Primary invoice email and a secondary AP contact for exceptions.
4) Remit/billing address for PO -> invoice matching.
5) Sample invoice (PDF) showing the VAT number and bank details.

I'll attach our short supplier onboarding form for you to fill out — it maps directly into our ERP (helps avoid rework). Can you return it with the items above? If you prefer, we can take the fields from the PDF you sent and I can submit on your behalf but we recommend returning the form to speed up setup.

Attachment: redwood_supplier_onboarding_form.pdf (fillable)

Next steps: once we have those items AP will map LedgerWorks to a PO routing rule (typically POs will route to purchasing@ledgerworks.com). Kimberly, is there any additional legal verification we should request for EU vendors here?

Best,
Sofia Ivanova
Procurement Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
sofia.ivanova@redwood.com

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 29 Jun 2027 15:20:00 +0000
Subject: Internal: LedgerWorks supplier profile — PO mapping question

Kimberly / Ben —

LedgerWorks (contact: Elena Rossi) sent the factsheet. They want PO routing to purchasing@ledgerworks.com and invoice delivery to invoices@ledgerworks.com. VAT GB987654321 included in their PDF.

Questions:
- Do we want to map the PO routing rule to "LedgerWorks - Purchasing" (ERP vendor code LW-UK) or use the incoming PO email as the primary matching key? My preference is to create the vendor code now (LW-UK) so future POs auto-match.
- Any additional verification required? Because they're EU-registered with a VAT, I think we can proceed with the VAT cert stub.
- For payment terms, they requested NET45 in the packet; should we default to our standard NET30 for first 3 invoices, then escalate to NET45 on approval?

Proposed action: Marissa, if you approve LW-UK vendor code and mapping to purchasing@ledgerworks.com, I'll return the onboarding form to Elena and request the sample invoice + bank stub.

Quoted for context:
> On Tue, 29 Jun 2027 at 12:03, Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com> wrote:
> > I'll attach our short supplier onboarding form for you to fill out — it maps directly into our ERP (helps avoid rework).

Thanks,
Sofia
